Heading: Landing in Korea for the first time?
Description: Here's what to do in order.

Heading: Get local apps: they just work better
Description: Naver Map + Papago. Locals use these. English supported.

Heading: Foreign cards don't always work
Description: Small shops accept Korean cards only. Bring some cash or get a WOWPASS.

Heading: Grab a WOWPASS at Incheon Airport
Description: Prepaid payment + transit card in one. Load with your native card.

Heading: AREX train to Seoul: fastest way in
Description: Express 11000 won (43 min). All-Stop 4750 won (60 min). Tap your WOWPASS.

Heading: Uber works for taxis
Description: Want more options? Get KakaoTaxi. It's what locals use.

Heading: Staying long-term? ARC then phone then bank
Description: This sequence unlocks Korean payments and delivery apps.
